notes: The portable scenario invokes only the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 Create/Destroy Federation Execution API with adapter-supplied IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM modules. It accepts a disjoint named extendable-variant alternative, rejects an overlapping different named alternative as InconsistentFOM, and checks name reuse after rejection. The native public-API focused CTest passed 2/2 including duplicate registrations; installed-package CTest passed 4/4 and direct runner passed 4/4 in both callback models (out/mgw/variant-alternative-20261021.json). The specific Annex C.3 variant continuation is clipped in the Requirements Lab (RL-319); the direct mapping is to the intact general named-data-type conflict rule, not a complete type-specific requirement. Java compiles against the API-only JAR, but provider runtime remains unverified; no conformance, HLAother, or general variant merge claim.
